keySentence: He met Rat by the river and they became friends.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Mole and Rat had a picnic on the river. They ate bread and cheese together. They became very good friends. He met Rat by the river and they became friends.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Mole and Rat floated down the river in a little boat. Rat brought a basket full of delicious food for lunch. They ate bread, cheese, and drank cold lemonade. He met Rat by the river and they became friends forever. Mole had never felt so happy in his whole life. Coming out of his underground home was the best decision ever.
